S-INT-IN-001.threat: Sender spoofing: Attacker impersonates {{sourceName}} to deceive {{targetName}}
S-INT-IN-001.cause: Missing sender authentication on incoming data flow — {{targetName}} cannot verify the true origin of received data
S-INT-IN-001.attack: Attacker forges the identity of {{sourceName}} and sends malicious data to {{targetName}}, which processes it as legitimate

S-INT-OUT-001.threat: Receiver spoofing: Attacker impersonates {{targetName}} to intercept data from {{sourceName}}
S-INT-OUT-001.cause: Missing endpoint validation before data transmission — {{sourceName}} cannot verify the true identity of the receiving endpoint
S-INT-OUT-001.attack: Attacker sets up a rogue endpoint pretending to be {{targetName}}, causing {{sourceName}} to send sensitive data to the attacker

T-INT-IN-001.threat: Data tampering on incoming flow: Attacker modifies data before it reaches {{targetName}}
T-INT-IN-001.cause: Missing integrity protection on the data flow from {{sourceName}} — data arrives without tamper evidence
T-INT-IN-001.attack: Attacker intercepts the data flow from {{sourceName}} and modifies commands or payload before delivery to {{targetName}}

T-INT-OUT-001.threat: Response tampering: Attacker modifies response data before it reaches {{sourceName}}
T-INT-OUT-001.cause: Missing integrity protection on the response flow from {{targetName}} — {{sourceName}} cannot detect modified responses
T-INT-OUT-001.attack: Attacker intercepts the response from {{targetName}} and modifies data, causing {{sourceName}} to process falsified information

R-INT-IN-001.threat: Sender repudiation: {{sourceName}} denies sending the request or data
R-INT-IN-001.cause: No non-repudiation mechanism on the data flow — requests from {{sourceName}} are not signed or cryptographically bound to the sender
R-INT-IN-001.attack: {{sourceName}} claims it never sent the command or data that {{targetName}} received and acted upon

R-INT-OUT-001.threat: Receiver repudiation: {{targetName}} denies receiving or processing the request
R-INT-OUT-001.cause: No delivery confirmation or cryptographic receipt — {{sourceName}} has no proof that {{targetName}} received its data
R-INT-OUT-001.attack: {{targetName}} claims it never received the data from {{sourceName}}, or denies having processed it

I-INT-IN-001.threat: Eavesdropping on incoming data: Attacker intercepts sensitive data flowing to {{targetName}}
I-INT-IN-001.cause: Unencrypted or weakly protected communication channel between {{sourceName}} and {{targetName}}
I-INT-IN-001.attack: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and reads sensitive payload transmitted from {{sourceName}} to {{targetName}}

I-INT-OUT-001.threat: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from {{targetName}}
I-INT-OUT-001.cause: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
I-INT-OUT-001.attack: Attacker intercepts the response from {{targetName}} to {{sourceName}} and reads sensitive information

D-INT-IN-001.threat: Request flooding: Attacker overwhelms {{targetName}} with excessive incoming requests
D-INT-IN-001.cause: No rate limiting or request throttling protecting {{targetName}} from high-volume input via {{sourceName}}
D-INT-IN-001.attack: Attacker sends a high volume of requests via the data flow, exhausting the processing capacity of {{targetName}}

D-INT-OUT-001.threat: Response blocking: Attacker prevents {{sourceName}} from receiving responses from {{targetName}}
D-INT-OUT-001.cause: No redundancy or timeout protection — {{sourceName}} depends on responses from {{targetName}} to continue operation
D-INT-OUT-001.attack: Attacker disrupts or delays the response channel from {{targetName}}, causing {{sourceName}} to stall or fail

E-INT-IN-001.threat: Command injection: Attacker injects commands via data flow to escalate privileges in {{targetName}}
E-INT-IN-001.cause: Insufficient input validation in {{targetName}} — incoming data from {{sourceName}} is processed with elevated trust
E-INT-IN-001.attack: Attacker injects malicious commands or payloads into the data flow, which {{targetName}} executes with its own privilege level

E-INT-OUT-001.threat: Response manipulation for privilege escalation: Attacker manipulates response to gain elevated access in {{sourceName}}
E-INT-OUT-001.cause: {{sourceName}} trusts response data from {{targetName}} without integrity verification, enabling privilege decisions based on forged responses
E-INT-OUT-001.attack: Attacker modifies the response from {{targetName}} to include elevated roles or permissions, causing {{sourceName}} to grant unauthorized access
